This '''wooden house''' in the [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] was the home of the Vaal family. Originally belonging to [[Zhari Vaal]], after his death the house was passed to his widow [[Adari Vaal|Adari]].
